description: Defines classes and methods for a custom memory pool allocator, including PoolAllocator and Allocation classes, with guard block sanity checking and memory management functionalities.

classes.name: Allocation
classes.description: Represents a memory allocation with optional guard blocks for sanity checking.

classes.name: PoolAllocator
classes.description: A custom memory pool allocator for efficient small memory requests, supporting push/pop stack semantics.

methods.name: Allocation::check
methods.description: Checks the integrity of guard blocks around the allocation.

methods.name: Allocation::AllocationSize
methods.description: Calculates total size needed for an allocation including guard blocks and header.

methods.name: Allocation::OffsetAllocation
methods.description: Returns pointer offset to user data from the surrounding buffer.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::push
methods.description: Establishes a new point to which memory can be popped.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::pop
methods.description: Frees all memory allocated since the last push.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::fastAllocate
methods.description: Provides a faster allocation path when alignment is 1.
